recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to white (#FFFFFF).
2. Draw a thin dark-red (#B22222) rectangle around the full slide perimeter, then a second thin dark-red (#B22222) rectangle just inside it (double border).
3. Draw a thin dark-red (#B22222) rectangle border around the title zone (top, full width, ~5-20% of slide height).
4. Place the title centered inside the title zone: 'Nearest Neighbors' in bold dark red (#B22222) followed by '(NN) Outlier Problem' in bold blue (#0000CC), large sans-serif.
5. Place the slide-number badge at the top-right corner: a yellow (#FFFF99) filled circle with a black (#000000) outline containing '45' in small dark text.
6. Left panel (middle-left, ~10-48% width, ~25-85% height): draw red (#B22222) L-shaped axes - a vertical line with an upward arrowhead on the left and a horizontal line with a rightward arrowhead at the bottom; no ticks or axis labels.
7. In the left panel, place ~10 filled green (#7CFC00) circles with thin dark outlines as a cluster at left/center.
8. In the left panel, place ~9 filled cyan (#00E5E5) circles with thin dark outlines as a cluster at upper-right.
9. In the left panel, place ~7 filled orange/tan (#F5C98A) circles with thin dark outlines as a cluster at the bottom.
10. In the left panel, add a small mouse-cursor arrow icon near the orange cluster (screen-recording artifact; may be omitted for a clean rebuild).
11. Below the left panel, place the caption 'Data of Three Classes' in bold dark red (#B22222), centered, smaller than the title.
12. Right panel (middle-right, ~52-90% width, ~25-85% height): replicate the step-6 axes exactly.
13. In the right panel, replicate the step-7-9 clusters identically (~10 green left/center, ~9 cyan upper-right, ~7 orange bottom).
14. In the right panel, place one filled red (#FF0000) circle (the outlier) between the green and cyan clusters.
15. In the right panel, draw one thin light-gray (#D3D3D3) connector line per point (~26 lines) from each point to its nearest neighbor, each ending in a small red arrowhead/dot; lines from all three clusters converge on the red outlier and its adjacent green point.
16. In the right panel, draw a dashed red circle around the green point closest to the red outlier (hex unspecified in source; use a clearly visible red such as #B22222).
17. Below the right panel, place the caption 'Nearest Neighbor is the Green class' in bold dark red (#B22222), centered, same size as the left caption.
